title: BANA DAAL
summary: A flagship event under Shubhkant Foundation that brings together aspiring entrepreneurs, young minds and visionary thinkers to turn potential into progress.
description: BANA DAAL is a flagship event organised under the auspices of Shubhkant Foundation. Conceived as a platform for innovation, learning and leadership, it brings together aspiring entrepreneurs, young minds and visionary thinkers to turn potential into progress.
highlights: Linking aspiring entrepreneurs, student innovators and startup founders with industry professionals, experienced mentors and potential investors.
Panel discussions and interactive sessions on business strategies, sustainable growth, funding awareness and technological innovation.
Pitching opportunities, practical learning and expert feedback.
Networking, interdisciplinary partnerships and professional relationships.
